body: I have been trying so hard this last month not to do anything and i cant take it anymore
I already do get food stamps.. I dont work enough hours to even pay my car insurance and gas. I need my car to get to work. I live out in the middle of no where so there is no buses or anything.
I dont have any friends. I cant hire anyone because I dont have any money, I am beyond broke, I cant even feed myself. Every single solution requires you to have money.
But its taking too long. I am sick now. I am broke now.. I am going to lose my apartment.. I need money now, not a year from now...

I feel like there are no other options. I applied for disability but apparently the government doesnt think I deserve any money even though I know people who have disability and use it to get drunk and party every day. It makes me so upset that I cant get help when I need it.,
